entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Dezful, also known as the Great Mosque of Desfool, is a Friday mosque located in Dezful, in the Dezful County of the province of Khuzestan, Iran. Situated on Imam Khomeini Street, the mosque was completed in c. 3rd or 4th century AH in the Sasanian architecture style, and is the oldest and first mosque in Dezful, and one of the oldest mosques in Iran.
